policy.noFakeMetadata: Do not close an item by inventing version numbers or declaring unsupported capabilities. Inspect canonical source and add real evidence.
policy.ownership: Implement in canonicalRepository; update central registry/integration metadata in the same coordinated change.
policy.release: A queue item is closed only when canonical tests pass and the scoped strict profile check passes.
